Class PathResource

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.core.io.AbstractResource
org.springframework.core.io.PathResource
All Implemented Interfaces:
InputStreamSource, Resource, WritableResource
@Deprecated(since="7.0", forRemoval=true) public class PathResource extends AbstractResource implements WritableResource
Deprecated, for removal: This API element is subject to removal in a future version.
自 7.0 版本起，推荐使用FileSystemResource。
Resource implementation for Path handles, performing all operations and transformations via the Path API. Supports resolution as a File and also as a URL. Implements the extended WritableResource interface.

注意：自 5.1 版本起，Path 支持也可在 FileSystemResource 中使用， 它应用 Spring 标准的基于字符串的路径转换，但通过 Files API 执行所有操作。 此 PathResource 本质上是一个基于纯 java.nio.path.Path 的替代方案，具有不同的 createRelative 行为。

Since:
4.0
Author:
Philippe Marschall，Juergen Hoeller

  • Constructor Details

    • PathResource

      public PathResource(Path path)
      Deprecated, for removal: This API element is subject to removal in a future version.
      Create a new PathResource from a Path handle.

      注意：与FileSystemResource不同，通过createRelative(String)构建相对资源时，相对路径将在给定的根目录之下构建：例如，Paths.get("C:/dir1/")，相对路径"dir2" → "C:/dir1/dir2"！

      Parameters:
      path - 一个路径句柄
